investigation_guidance: At pre_transaction, correlate supplier profile change, new beneficiary, and communication risk before payment initiates.
Escalate step_up to hold only after legitimate_alternatives fails to explain the co-occurring profile and communication signals.
Preserve allow paths for cases fully resolved by legitimate context to keep friction and false positives flat.
final_defense_playbook.change_hypothesis: Escalating proportionately from step_up to hold earlier in pre_transaction when beneficiary_novelty, profile_change, and communication_risk co-occur and legitimate alternatives are exhausted should lift value_prevented and close the pre_transaction lifecycle gap without adding legitimate friction or hard false positives.
